@lru_cache(maxsize=1024 * 128)
def _path_to_elements(path, root_element=DEFAULT_FIRST_ELEMENT):
    elements = []
    if not path or path == 'root':
        return elements
    
    i = 0
    while i < len(path):
        if path[i] == '[':
            i += 1
            if i < len(path) and path[i] in {'"', "'"}:
                quote_char = path[i]
                i += 1
                current_elem = ''
                while i < len(path) and path[i] != quote_char:
                    current_elem += path[i]
                    i += 1
                i += 1
                _add_to_elements(elements, f'{quote_char}{current_elem}{quote_char}', '[')
            else:
                current_elem = ''
                while i < len(path) and path[i] != ']':
                    current_elem += path[i]
                    i += 1
                _add_to_elements(elements, current_elem, '[')
            i += 1
        elif path[i] == '.':
            i += 1
            current_elem = ''
            while i < len(path) and path[i] not in {'[', '.'}:
                current_elem += path[i]
                i += 1
            if current_elem:
                _add_to_elements(elements, current_elem, '.')
        else:
            i += 1
    
    return elements


def parse_path(path, root_element=DEFAULT_FIRST_ELEMENT, include_actions=False):
    elements = _path_to_elements(path, root_element)
    
    if not include_actions:
        return [elem for elem, action in elements]
    else:
        return [{'element': elem, 'action': action} for elem, action in elements]
